outcome: incidence of histopathological features of chronic endometritis (stromal edema, stromal cell compaction)
cohort: 102 women undergoing outpatient hysteroscopy with immunohistochemical diagnosis of chronic endometritis based on plasma cell density.
finding: Polypectomy alone reduced plasma cell density without antibiotics, while antibiotic treatment significantly decreased plasma cell density and resolved chronic endometritis features in cases without focal lesions.
followup_time: third menstrual cycle after the initial procedure
